**Issues this wave advances:** #

**Workers and their disjoint paths**

- [ ] Workers returned; receipt lines appended to `docs/VERIFICATION_RECEIPTS.tsv`
- [ ] Reviewer findings repaired in-wave
- [ ] One integrated broad run (+ serial device run if native conduct changed, + Lean build if Lean changed)
- [ ] Issues reconciled: closed with the commit, or narrowed to the concrete absent object; new ones opened
- [ ] Owner map, state and roadmap updated; committed and pushed
